overview.headline: Early saving lets compound interest grow money faster for future education costs

keyPoints.point: Starting early lets your money grow faster from compound interest for post-secondary education
keyPoints.quote: The sooner you start saving for post-secondary education, the faster your money can grow from compound interest.

keyPoints.point: Compound interest means you earn interest on both saved money and prior interest
keyPoints.quote: Compound interest is when you earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn.

keyPoints.point: Increasing compounding frequency, interest rate, or principal helps your savings grow faster
keyPoints.quote: Increasing the compounding frequency or your interest rate or adding to your principal can help your savings grow even faster.

keyPoints.point: An online calculator shows how time and compound interest increase savings
keyPoints.quote: Use an online calculator to understand how time and compound interest can increase savings.

keyTerms.gloss: interest earned on both saved money and previously earned interest that builds savings
keyTerms.quote: Compound interest is when you earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn.

keyTerms.gloss: initial principal amount you invest that can earn interest over time
keyTerms.quote: So let's say you invest $1,000 (your principal) and it earns 5 percent (interest rate) once a year (the compounding frequency).

keyTerms.gloss: percentage charged for borrowing or paid for saving that determines interest earned
keyTerms.quote: Interest rate: A percentage of a sum borrowed that is charged by a lender or merchant for letting you use its money.

keyTerms.gloss: something you spend money on expecting a financial return later
keyTerms.quote: Investment: Something you spend your money on that you expect will earn a financial return.

keyTerms.gloss: all forms of schooling after high school including college and other training paths
keyTerms.quote: Post-secondary education: Includes all forms of schooling after high school, not just college.
